description: WALL TILE WT-1 3x12 ROCA FLOW WHITE
source: markup p16 (A-410) WT1 WALL TILE; p27 (A-703) WT1 WALL TILE; p32 (A-705) WT1 WALL TILE
formula: sum of WT1 field areas traced on interior elevations (field net of WT-2/WT-9 accent tiles)
notes: A-410 area covers both restrooms (Womens elevations B/C/D traced, polygons copied for Mens per note MENS SIMILAR TO WOMENS). Fixtures, mirror, equipment not deducted. Legend shows 1 decimal; line carries PlanSwift precision.

description: WALL TILE WT-2 3x12 ROCA FLOW COSMIC SAPPHIRE
source: markup p16 (A-410), p27 (A-703), p32 (A-705) WT2 WALL TILE
formula: sum of WT-2 accent tiles traced tile-by-tile on elevations
notes: 0.17% is legend 1-decimal display rounding. Schedule MIX 20% would give 48.83 SF (+4.5%); estimator traced the drawn pattern instead.

description: WALL TILE WT-3 6x12 MOSA MURALS DARK ANTHRACITE
source: markup p23 (A-700) WT3 TILE; A-700 detail 4 TRANSACTION BAR - FRONT ELEVATION; detail 3 TRANSACTION BAR - BACK ELEVATION
sourceValues: 38.4 SF legend; printed 10'-6 3/4" (3/A-700, face of wall to outside of waterfall edge) less 2 x 1 1/4" SLD-1 returns = 10'-4 1/4" x 3'-8 1/2" = 38.40 SF; vector field 10'-4 3/8" x 3'-8 1/2" = 38.44 SF
formula: tile field W x H on the front elevation (inside the SLD-1 waterfall edge); W = printed bar length less the two 1 1/4" returns
notes: Printed basis 38.40 SF (-0.06%), vector check 38.44 SF (+0.05%). Same 38.4 SF area also carried as 1/4" CEMENTITIOUS BACKER BOARD and PL-4 FINISH on p23 (other trades).

description: WALL TILE WT-9 3x12 ROCA FLOW TENDER GRAY
source: markup p16 (A-410), p27 (A-703), p32 (A-705) WT9 WALL TILE
formula: sum of WT-9 tiles traced on elevations (lower grey band + accents)
notes: Schedule MIX 20% would give 48.83 SF (-8.3%). Restroom split 56/20/24 vs schedule 60/20/20.

description: WALL COVERING WC-1 FORMULA VARIES BY FOCUS MARKET
source: markup p08 (A-150) WC1 @ 12'H; A-130 WEATHER VESTIBULE 100 ceiling 12'-0" A.F.F.
formula: run LF x height (height in the legend name = ceiling height)
notes: Recomputed 121.2 SF is +1.0%. 120 = 10.0 LF x 12 ft: estimator rounded the run (or overrode the quantity); not provable from the data. Spec p015 matrix lists vinyl wall covering as Owner-furnished, Owner-installed.

description: WALL COVERING @ PT7 PAINT - ASSUMED WALL COVERING, V.I.F
source: markup p08 (A-150) WALL COVERING @ 10'H ABOVE PT7 (also PT7 @ 10'); A-170 PT-7 = PRIMER, SHIELDZ UNIVERSAL WALLCOVERING / ROMAN PRO-999
sourceValues: 10.3 FT x 10 ft (MEETING ROOM 105 ceiling 10'-0" A.F.F.)
formula: run LF x height; wallcovering inferred from a wallcovering-primer-only paint tag
notes: PT-7 is a clear-drying wallcovering primer COORDINATE w/ OWNER VENDOR; nothing on the drawings shows a wallcovering tag on this wall, so the estimator assumed one and marked it V.I.F.
